tagline: Urban Climate · Urban Data and Sensing · Complex Systems
description: Cities extend their influence far beyond their physical boundaries, affecting ecosystems, climate, and societies worldwide. At the Urban Planet Lab, we study the dynamics and impacts of urbanization at multiple scales—from local neighborhoods to global systems—to better understand and address the complex challenges of our increasingly urbanized world.

cards.title: Urban Data and Sensing
cards.description: Observing and Measuring the city to Investigating how cities can adapt to and mitigate the impacts of climate change through data-driven policy and design.

cards.title: Complex Systems
cards.description: Cities and extreme weather are two complex dynamical systems that interact across scales, and urban heat is one of the many emergent outcomes.
